description.value: The Comox Valley Art Gallery is an independent non-profit public gallery in Courtenay dedicated to presenting contemporary art by regional, national, and international professional artists. Operating on the unceded territory of the K'ómoks Nation, it mounts rotating exhibitions alongside community art projects, creative residencies, public performances, and youth mentorship programs. A gift shop selling work from hundreds of local artists rounds out the visit, making it a culturally rich stop in the heart of the Comox Valley.
